postView.description: A video post hydrated by an AppView: the author's record plus derived, playable media. 'playlist' and 'thumbnail' point at renditions the AppView's media pipeline produced from the record's video blob; they are not part of the record.

record.description: The social.openreel.video.post record as stored in the author's repository.

playlist.description: HLS multivariant playlist (.m3u8) for the video.

thumbnail.description: Poster image shown before playback starts.

durationMs.description: Duration of the transcoded video in milliseconds, as measured by the media pipeline.

handle.description: Handle claimed in the author's DID document, if any.
